referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A pale construction-site photograph carries a very large black compressed headline, thin yellow rule and practical tender action. Two-level utility navigation separates procurement/contact details from capabilities, sectors and project routes. Extra-heavy industrial grotesk for poster-like statements, narrow body text and small uppercase yellow chapter labels. Warm white, concrete gray, charcoal and warning yellow. Construction site, groundwork and project photographs are set into a relatively spare information grid. The full sequence runs from industrial poster hero to metrics strip to capability grid toward handover process, accreditation line, tender form. The template's company, metrics, accreditations, projects, tender values and people are fictional demo content.
